description: QR code component that renders strings as QR codes with color, size and center icon options.

props.description: Dark module color for the QR code.
props.name: color

props.description: QR error correction level; higher levels tolerate more occlusion.
props.name: errorCorrectionLevel

props.description: Background color behind the center icon.
props.name: iconBackgroundColor

props.description: Center icon background corner radius in pixels.
props.name: iconBorderRadius

props.description: Padding between the QR content and outer edge, in pixels.
props.name: padding

props.description: Overall QR code display size in pixels.
props.name: size

props.description: QR rendering mode: canvas or SVG.
props.name: type

props.description: Content encoded into the QR code.
props.name: value
